brief: 5 burnout warning signs every founder ignores until it's too late.

slots.body: You are not just tired. Ignoring these red flags will cost you your health and your company.
Founders wear exhaustion like a badge until their body forces a hard stop. These five signs appear long before the crash.
slots.quote: Burnout is not success; it's a collapse.

slots.body: You used to love the mission. Now every morning feels like a battle you have already lost before starting.
slots.quote: Dreading Monday is your first red flag.

slots.body: Your team annoys you. Customers feel like burdens. When empathy vanishes, leadership becomes impossible and isolation takes over completely.
slots.quote: When everyone irritates you, check yourself first.

slots.body: Simple choices drain you for hours. Creativity vanishes. You stare at emails unable to respond, yet you blame your tools.
slots.quote: Brain fog is your nervous system screaming.

slots.body: You trade gym sessions for Slack replies and sleep for spreadsheets. Your body remembers everything and always collects its debt.
slots.quote: You cannot scale a business on fumes.

slots.body: Nothing recharges you anymore. Friends become strangers. If hobbies feel like chores, your tank has been empty for months.
slots.quote: Losing joy is the final warning bell.

slots.body: Your startup cannot survive if its founder is running on empty. Rest is a strategy, not a weakness to hide.
